bugs.error_message: openwolf.ps1 cannot be loaded because running scripts is disabled on this system
bugs.root_cause: Windows PowerShell execution policy blocks the npm-generated PowerShell shim.
bugs.fix: Invoke openwolf.cmd instead of changing the machine execution policy.

bugs.error_message: npm.ps1 cannot be loaded because running scripts is disabled on this system
bugs.root_cause: Windows PowerShell execution policy blocks the npm PowerShell shim.
bugs.fix: Invoke npm.cmd for project commands.

bugs.error_message: failed to connect to the docker API at npipe:////./pipe/docker_engine
bugs.root_cause: Docker Desktop engine is not currently running or its named pipe is unavailable.
bugs.fix: Start Docker Desktop before running PostgreSQL containers or integration tests.

bugs.error_message: apply_patch verification failed for Unicode OpenWolf headings
bugs.root_cause: PowerShell rendered UTF-8 headings as mojibake, so copied patch context did not match the file bytes.
bugs.fix: Read controlled files explicitly as UTF-8 and use separate delete/add patches when full replacement is needed.

bugs.error_message: pip could not connect to PyPI while installing hatchling in the sandbox
bugs.root_cause: The default workspace sandbox blocks outbound package downloads.
bugs.fix: Re-ran the scoped backend virtual-environment install with approved network access.

bugs.error_message: Initial Ruff and mypy quality checks failed on import formatting and Settings test typing
bugs.root_cause: Fresh files had not yet been Ruff-formatted and mypy does not expose Pydantic Settings' private _env_file constructor argument.
bugs.fix: Applied Ruff fixes/formatting and tested Settings through its public constructor with a typed pytest MonkeyPatch.

bugs.error_message: Failed to create unified exec process: helper_unknown_error: apply deny-read ACLs
bugs.root_cause: The Windows sandbox helper failed while launching three final checks in parallel.
bugs.fix: Ran the final checks sequentially; pip and Git validations succeeded.

bugs.error_message: OpenWolf anatomy scan indexed 513 files after backend/.venv was created
bugs.root_cause: OpenWolf anatomy exclusion patterns are independent from Git ignore rules and did not include Python virtual environments.
bugs.fix: Added .venv, venv, .mypy_cache, .pytest_cache, and .ruff_cache to OpenWolf anatomy exclude_patterns and regenerated the index.

bugs.error_message: npm install waited silently for network access inside the sandbox
bugs.root_cause: npm retried blocked registry requests without producing timely output.
bugs.fix: Interrupted the sandboxed process and used scoped approved network access. The frontend was later removed after the product pivot.

bugs.error_message: ESLint 10 produced an invalid peer dependency tree under Next.js plugins
bugs.root_cause: Several transitive Next.js lint plugins supported ESLint 9 but not ESLint 10.
bugs.fix: Reverted to the compatible ESLint version before the frontend scaffold was removed by the product pivot.

bugs.error_message: Root CLI package installation could not download hatchling in the default sandbox
bugs.root_cause: Outbound package downloads are blocked in the default workspace sandbox.
bugs.fix: Re-ran the isolated root .venv install with scoped approved network access.

bugs.error_message: graphit version was rejected because Typer exposed the only command as the root command
bugs.root_cause: Typer simplifies a single-command application unless it has a root callback.
bugs.fix: Added a documented root callback so Graphit remains a command group and graphit version is stable.

bugs.error_message: The `graphit` PyPI distribution name is already owned by an unrelated legacy project
bugs.root_cause: Product/CLI naming was selected before checking the public package index namespace.
bugs.fix: Changed only the distribution name to graphit-db while preserving the Graphit brand, graphit import package, and graphit CLI command.

bugs.error_message: rg treated part of a double-quoted PowerShell pattern as a file path
bugs.root_cause: Backslash escaping used shell semantics that do not apply to PowerShell double-quoted command arguments.
bugs.fix: Used a single-quoted ripgrep pattern for literal embedded double quotes.

bugs.error_message: Stale-architecture validation flagged intentional negative and superseded FastAPI/Next.js references
bugs.root_cause: The initial text search matched technology names without considering whether they documented removal or active use.
bugs.fix: Narrowed validation to active architecture phrases while preserving historical/superseded decisions.

bugs.error_message: PermissionError: access denied to the default pytest temporary directory
bugs.root_cause: The sandbox cannot enumerate the OS-level pytest temp directory on Windows.
bugs.fix: Configured pytest --basetemp=.pytest-tmp, ignored local test artifacts in Git and excluded the temp tree from OpenWolf anatomy.

bugs.error_message: WinError 1314: privilege not held when creating symlink in test
bugs.root_cause: This Windows account cannot create symlinks; runtime symlink rejection remains independent of test setup.
bugs.fix: Skip only the symlink-specific test when symlink creation is denied.

bugs.error_message: Non-Git fixture inherited Graphit repository Git root via workspace-local pytest temp directory
bugs.root_cause: Moving test temp into the workspace also placed all temp projects under the repository's .git ancestor.
bugs.fix: Mocked the Git-presence predicate in the one isolated non-Git test; kept real Git-root tests separately.

bugs.error_message: Ruff flagged one long condition, import order, and formatter changes in the new SQLite-store slice
bugs.root_cause: Initial new code did not fully match project Ruff line length, import sorting, and formatting rules.
bugs.fix: Split the condition and assertion, sorted imports, ran Ruff formatter, and reran all quality gates successfully.

bugs.error_message: Ruff flagged three overlong lines and formatting differences in the source-management slice
bugs.root_cause: New command signatures and test argument lists exceeded the configured 100-character line limit and formatter layout.
bugs.fix: Wrapped the signatures and ran the project Ruff formatter before the final quality-gate pass.

bugs.error_message: pip install -e . could not download hatchling because the default sandbox blocked network access
bugs.root_cause: The Windows workspace sandbox blocks package downloads; the error looked like a missing hatchling distribution.
bugs.fix: Repeated the scoped project-venv install with approved network access; Psycopg and the editable package installed successfully.

bugs.error_message: pytest collected imported application function test_connection and reported fixture 'source' not found
bugs.root_cause: A production function with a test_ prefix was imported into a pytest test module, making it look like a test case.
bugs.fix: Renamed the production function to verify_connection and updated CLI/tests; all 52 tests now pass.

bugs.error_message: Ruff flagged an overlong test case and formatter differences in new CLI tests
bugs.root_cause: Initial test parameter and CLI argument layout did not match the repository formatter.
bugs.fix: Wrapped the long parameter and formatted the CLI test file; Ruff checks pass.

bugs.error_message: Source command-group help still said definitions were managed without connecting after source test was added
bugs.root_cause: The source group help text reflected the previous add/list/show-only slice.
bugs.fix: Updated CLI help to say sources can be managed and verified; final tests and lint pass.

bugs.error_message: Ruff flagged scanner import order and Iterator placement; format check flagged scanner code and architecture code fence
bugs.root_cause: New scanner imports and documentation code block did not match the repository Ruff rules.
bugs.fix: Sorted imports, moved Iterator to collections.abc, and formatted the scanner and architecture document; final gates pass.

bugs.error_message: New FK tests failed with SCHEMA_NOT_FOUND and the constraint-limit fixture raised IndexError; Ruff requested zip(strict=) and formatting
bugs.root_cause: The scripted catalog initially ignored selected-schema filtering and used empty tuples for limit rows, unlike real parameterized PostgreSQL results.
bugs.fix: Made the fake apply schema parameters, used representative constraint rows for overflow, set zip(strict=True), and formatted the test file; all 70 tests pass.

bugs.error_message: mypy rejected a reused tuple-key variable and Ruff flagged snapshot/test formatting
bugs.root_cause: Schema, table, column, and constraint keys reused one variable name with incompatible tuple types; new code also exceeded line-length and formatter rules.
bugs.fix: Used distinct typed key names and formatted the affected source/tests; full quality gates pass.

bugs.error_message: Ruff reported overlong search/CLI lines and a search-order test expected a table before an exact schema match
bugs.root_cause: New code needed repository formatting, and the test overlooked that exact object-name relevance outranks object-type preference.
bugs.fix: Formatted new code and corrected the test to expect the exact schema hit first; all 91 tests and quality gates pass.

bugs.error_message: Table-context test found missing UNIQUE key; Ruff flagged long lines and mypy rejected untyped JSON fields
bugs.root_cause: Snapshot writer persisted unique-key edges as UNIQUE while the documented graph and reader used UNIQUE_KEY; JSON values needed explicit validation/narrowing, and new lines needed formatting.
bugs.fix: Write UNIQUE_KEY for new snapshots, accept both UNIQUE and UNIQUE_KEY in readers, validate JSON fields, and format code; 103 tests and quality gates pass.

bugs.error_message: Ruff flagged overlong relationship-query helper and test lines
bugs.root_cause: The first extraction of exact table resolution and a test SQL string exceeded the repository's 100-character limit.
bugs.fix: Formatted the query helper and split the long test SQL string; all 108 tests, Ruff, and mypy pass.

bugs.error_message: Ruff flagged long path CLI/test lines and format check flagged the CLI path header
bugs.root_cause: The new path output string and compact FK test fixtures exceeded the 100-character repository limit.
bugs.fix: Formatted fixtures and split the CLI header construction; 113 tests, Ruff, and mypy pass.

bugs.error_message: pip install mcp failed with WinError 10013 inside network sandbox
bugs.root_cause: Sandbox blocks package download socket access for the default command.
bugs.fix: Retried the exact scoped package install with approved network escalation; mcp 2.2.0 installed and pip check passes.

bugs.error_message: MCP tests assumed list_tools was iterable and unquoted public.Customer resolved mixed case
bugs.root_cause: SDK returns ListToolsResult with .tools; PostgreSQL unquoted identifiers fold to lowercase.
bugs.fix: Read tools.tools and use a quoted mixed-case table identifier; MCP tool and stdio tests pass.

bugs.error_message: Ruff format check and mypy failed on MCP test formatting and ToolAnnotations camelCase keywords; one SDK source lookup used a nonexistent types.py path
bugs.root_cause: Pydantic wire aliases are not accepted by the static constructor signature; the MCP types module is a package, not a top-level types.py file.
bugs.fix: Use snake_case annotation fields, run Ruff formatter, inspect model fields at runtime, and rerun all tests and quality gates successfully.

bugs.error_message: MCP SDK duplicated tool JSON in both content and structured_content, including when returning a plain string
bugs.root_cause: SDK v2 automatically constructs unstructured and structured representations for annotated plain return values.
bugs.fix: Return an explicit CallToolResult with one compact JSON TextContent block, and assert structured_content is absent in in-process and real stdio tests.

bugs.error_message: Ruff E501 flagged two new MCP path test lines; mypy rejected iteration over object-valued JSON steps
bugs.root_cause: The new test literals exceeded 100 characters and JSON results were intentionally typed as object until narrowed.
bugs.fix: Split long input dictionaries, assert path steps are lists before iteration, and verify relationship/path limit and budget errors; focused and full tests, Ruff, and mypy pass.

bugs.error_message: Overview change initially failed Ruff import/format checks and mypy rejected chained equality between schema-name and entry-table tuples
bugs.root_cause: New imports and multiline fixtures did not match Ruff ordering/layout, while the two result collections have intentionally different element types.
bugs.fix: Sort imports, use a short query-result type alias, split the two empty-list assertions, format the touched files, and rerun all 125 tests plus Ruff and mypy successfully.

bugs.error_message: First MCP documentation patch failed to match a Unicode flow diagram; Ruff flagged context-tool import ordering, long lines, and one tuple-format check
bugs.root_cause: PowerShell output showed Unicode arrows as mojibake, while manually compacted Python lines and tuple fixtures differed from repository Ruff formatting.
bugs.fix: Applied smaller ASCII-context documentation patches, split long Python expressions, organized imports, formatted tests, and reran 131 tests plus Ruff/mypy/pip check successfully.

bugs.error_message: Ruff E501 and format check failed on new Codex setup code and tests
bugs.root_cause: A new error line exceeded the 100-character limit and multiline string/test literals did not match Ruff's formatter.
bugs.fix: Formatted the two files with Ruff and reran all 138 tests, Ruff, mypy, and pip check successfully.

bugs.error_message: mypy: tests/test_claude.py:53: Value of type 'object' is not indexable
bugs.root_cause: A heterogeneous nested test fixture was inferred with object-valued entries under strict mypy.
bugs.fix: Assert the preserved other-server object directly instead of indexing the heterogeneously typed fixture; mypy passes.

bugs.error_message: Two broad documentation patches failed to match exact CLI/DATA_MODEL text; Ruff E501 and format check failed on new inference code/tests
bugs.root_cause: Patch context assumed line wording that differed from the current documents, and newly written code exceeded the repository's 100-character format style.
bugs.fix: Used small exact-context documentation patches, formatted the two Python files with Ruff, and reran all 155 tests plus Ruff, mypy, and pip check successfully.

bugs.error_message: Inference benchmark revealed an inferred legacy target for a source column with a confirmed CRM FK; Ruff format check failed on the new test fixture
bugs.root_cause: Metadata v1 suppresses only the exact declared column pair, leaving alternative targets for the same FK source column; the hand-written fixture also differed from Ruff's multiline style.
bugs.fix: Preserved the rule unchanged for a valid baseline, documented the false positive as the next precision fix, formatted the benchmark test, and reran 156 tests plus Ruff/mypy/pip check successfully.

bugs.error_message: A source column with a confirmed database FK still produced an inferred alternative target; Ruff format check failed on new FK regression fixtures
bugs.root_cause: V1 checked only exact declared source/target column pairs, and out-of-scope FK targets lack column-level REFERENCES edges. New test constructors also differed from Ruff's multiline style.
bugs.fix: V2 maps ordered source columns from bounded confirmed table-level FK metadata and suppresses all alternatives from those columns, including composite/external FKs; formatted tests and reran 158 tests plus Ruff/mypy/pip check.

bugs.error_message: Broad test and documentation patches failed to match existing formatted lines
bugs.root_cause: Patch context assumed different line wrapping than the current Ruff-formatted test and paragraph layout.
bugs.fix: Inspected exact surrounding lines, applied smaller context-specific patches, formatted changed Python files, and reran the full 158-test suite plus Ruff, mypy, and pip check.

bugs.error_message: Initial review slice failed Ruff line/format checks and strict mypy on a dynamic test wrapper
bugs.root_cause: New command and exception lines exceeded the project style, and a generic *args/**kwargs monkeypatch wrapper lost the preview function's typed signature.
bugs.fix: Used an explicitly typed wrapper, formatted touched files with Ruff, and reran 165 tests plus Ruff, mypy, and pip check successfully.

bugs.error_message: Initial restore refactor patch failed to match the existing SQL block; Ruff format check flagged a new CLI test argument list
bugs.root_cause: The broad patch included an incorrect triple-quote context; the new test list also differed from Ruff's multiline layout.
bugs.fix: Reapplied the refactor in smaller exact-context patches, formatted the test file, and reran 169 tests plus Ruff, mypy, and pip check successfully.

bugs.error_message: Ruff format check rejected new approval test assertion and CLI argument layouts
bugs.root_cause: The hand-written new test block did not match Ruff's multiline formatting conventions.
bugs.fix: Formatted the test file, added fail-closed malformed-decision and declared-FK isolation coverage, then reran 175 tests plus Ruff, mypy, and pip check successfully.

bugs.error_message: Ruff format check flagged new revocation helper calls and test assertions
bugs.root_cause: Hand-written multiline calls and tuples did not match the project's Ruff formatter layout.
bugs.fix: Formatted the two files and reran 179 tests plus Ruff, mypy, and pip check successfully.

bugs.error_message: Ruff rejected long graph/test lines and a lambda assigned as a sort key
bugs.root_cause: Initial projection code exceeded the 100-character limit and used a named lambda contrary to E731.
bugs.fix: Split long expressions, replaced the lambda with a typed local function, formatted affected files, and reran 184 tests plus Ruff, mypy, and pip check successfully.

bugs.error_message: PowerShell could not find .\openwolf.cmd from the repository root
bugs.root_cause: OpenWolf is on PATH, not stored as a command file in this workspace.
bugs.fix: Ran openwolf.cmd scan from PATH successfully; anatomy indexed 63 files.

bugs.error_message: Ruff flagged extraneous generator parentheses and overlong HTML/SVG/CSS lines
bugs.root_cause: Hand-written SVG/CSS strings exceeded style limits and wrapped a generator unnecessarily.
bugs.fix: Split SVG and CSS strings, simplified the generator expression, then reran the full 197-test suite plus Ruff, formatter, mypy, and pip check successfully.

bugs.error_message: Ruff rejected one long type annotation and multiline tuple formatting in the new benchmark
bugs.root_cause: The hand-written benchmark used a 103-character signature and a tuple layout differing from Ruff formatter rules.
bugs.fix: Formatted the test, kept labels independent, and reran the 200-test suite plus Ruff, formatter, mypy, and pip check successfully.

bugs.error_message: Discovery benchmark first ran under system Python without MCP; an initial assertion then incorrectly required the selector not to be truncated; Ruff found an overlong line and formatting mismatch.
bugs.root_cause: The command omitted the project virtual environment, and the new test conflated a bounded response's truncation flag with a failure before formatting was applied.
bugs.fix: Use .venv Python, record truncation as a metric, and format the benchmark test before final verification.

bugs.error_message: Ruff rejected one 101-character assertion; two STATUS.md patches and one memory.md patch failed to match their expected text.
bugs.root_cause: The test expression exceeded the 100-character limit, and hand-written OpenWolf patch context did not match the files exactly, including a Unicode dash.
bugs.fix: Formatted the test with Ruff, reread the exact UTF-8 memory tail, applied small matching patches, and repeated quality checks.

bugs.error_message: Ruff format --check rejected multiline helper signatures and a max() assertion in the scaled benchmark.
bugs.root_cause: The handwritten line breaks differed from Ruff's formatting rules despite passing Ruff lint and pytest.
bugs.fix: Formatted both test files with Ruff and reran the quality gates.

bugs.error_message: A 174-table name-overlap fixture hid sales.payment and sales.invoice from top-three context; the prior top-1 >= 3 benchmark assertion failed after the ranking fix; Ruff format rejected the new test signature.
bugs.root_cause: Final relevance ranking discarded the per-term search's exact object-name priority and resolved equal term-count matches alphabetically; the old top-1 assertion assumed the previous order.
bugs.fix: Added an exact object-name tie-break after existing term, scope, and kind criteria; updated the benchmark to guard top-three focus and labeled graph evidence while reporting the honest top-1 trade-off; formatted the test signature.

bugs.error_message: Manual-proposal malformed-FK test did not raise; Ruff check and format reported overlong/unformatted lines; one rg pattern was invalid.
bugs.root_cause: The test corrupted FK metadata outside the proposed source table; initial handwritten lines exceeded project formatting rules; the search regex escaped a literal command incorrectly.
bugs.fix: Test the payment source column that owns a declared FK, format the edited Python files, and use simpler text searches. Proposal validation fails closed on malformed adjacent FK metadata.

bugs.error_message: A PowerShell brace-list path caused a ParserError; Ruff check reported one overlong SQL test string and Ruff format reported one unformatted tuple expression.
bugs.root_cause: The shell command used Bash-style path braces in PowerShell, and handwritten test lines differed from Ruff's configured style. The new proposal listing also required explicit corrupt-history validation.
bugs.fix: Used a plain src/graphit search path, split the SQL test string, formatted the test file, and added fail-closed validation for malformed local proposal history.

bugs.error_message: The manual-proposal corrupt-history test failed after APPROVED became a valid event; an initial documentation patch did not match the exact CLI wording; initial Ruff check found three overlong approval lines.
bugs.root_cause: The old test treated every APPROVED manual event as corruption, whereas explicit approval now makes it valid. Documentation and formatting assumptions were not synchronized with the actual file contents.
bugs.fix: Changed the corrupt fixture to UNKNOWN, applied smaller exact-context documentation patches, and formatted the approval code. Added explicit validation and snapshot/conflict error handling for manual approval.

bugs.error_message: Human-readable review proposals output labeled an already APPROVED manual proposal as PROPOSED (not approved); Ruff reported an unsorted CLI import during revocation work.
bugs.root_cause: The CLI used a fixed proposal label despite status becoming dynamic after approval; adding revoke_manual_proposal placed it before revoke_approval alphabetically.
bugs.fix: Render each manual proposal's actual latest status, add explicit REVOKED review history and re-proposal state handling, and sort the CLI imports.

bugs.error_message: Manual graph tests assumed crm.customer had no existing FK; test import was unused and MCP content needed type narrowing; an HTML test failed after its existing APPROVED legend text changed.
bugs.root_cause: The ERP fixture already contains a confirmed payment-to-customer FK, and the old HTML legend wording was an asserted output contract. The new MCP test initially accessed a union-typed content item without narrowing.
bugs.fix: Assert manual links by provenance while retaining the FK, narrow MCP content to TextContent, remove the unused import, and preserve the original HTML legend while adding a separate manual legend.

bugs.error_message: Ruff flagged an unused import and incorrectly ordered imports during MCP manual-link test work.
bugs.root_cause: The new test imports were added while the test shape was still changing.
bugs.fix: Removed the unused import and sorted the remaining imports; full Ruff and test checks now pass.

bugs.error_message: Ruff format --check found one unformatted multiline assertion in the new ERP benchmark test.
bugs.root_cause: The assertion was written with a noncanonical multiline generator layout.
bugs.fix: Ran Ruff format on the targeted test file and passed the full formatter gate.

bugs.error_message: Initial view-slice quality gates found a Python literal-type mismatch and one overlong, unformatted test assertion.
bugs.root_cause: The relkind mapping inferred plain str instead of the constrained relation kind, and the assertion exceeded the formatter width.
bugs.fix: Introduced the shared RelationKind alias, typed the mapping, and formatted the targeted test file; full gates pass.

bugs.error_message: Initial view-detail checks found tuple inference errors, two formatting violations, and three legacy assertions expecting no get_view MCP tool or view follow-up.
bugs.root_cause: The new fixture extended fixed-length inferred tuples, two lines exceeded formatter width, and exact tool-list/selector contracts changed intentionally.
bugs.fix: Annotated variable-length fixture tuples, formatted targeted files, and updated exact contract tests; full suite and quality gates pass.

bugs.error_message: Docker API was inaccessible inside the default sandbox; the first integration-test draft had an unsafe partial-setup cleanup boundary and initial Ruff/mypy issues.
bugs.root_cause: Docker's Windows named pipe requires scoped escalation; generated schema names were initially marked for cleanup before CREATE succeeded, and conninfo typing/formatting needed explicit handling.
bugs.fix: Used read-only Docker diagnostics with scoped approval, recorded only successfully created schemas/roles for cleanup, sanitized DSN parsing, typed return values, and formatted the test. A disposable PostgreSQL 16 run and all gates now pass; the container was stopped and auto-removed.

bugs.error_message: Initial build dependency download was sandbox-blocked; default sdist included .wolf/.codex/.claude; elevated process could not access a clean venv under .pytest-tmp.
bugs.root_cause: The default sandbox denies package-index sockets, Hatchling's default sdist selection traversed unignored local agent state, and the elevated Windows context lacked access to the .pytest-tmp venv path.
bugs.fix: Used scoped build/install approval, configured an explicit sdist allowlist, rebuilt and inspected archives, and ran isolated wheel installation from a separate venv under .venv.

bugs.error_message: Initial package-check quality gates found an unformatted set literal, a mypy assignment mismatch from reusing the sdist names variable for wheel names, and a Ruff import-spacing violation.
bugs.root_cause: The first draft reused one variable for set and list archive collections and hand-formatted a long literal/import gap inconsistently with project lint rules.
bugs.fix: Split wheel_names from sdist names, formatted the required set literal and import gap, and reran the full 233-test suite plus Ruff, mypy, archive check, and isolated wheel smoke successfully.

bugs.error_message: Installed-wheel smoke passed init/MCP work but failed temporary-directory cleanup on Windows with WinError 32 for graphit.db; initial script also exceeded Ruff's line-length limit.
bugs.root_cause: sqlite3.Connection as a context manager commits/rolls back but does not close the handle, leaving the temporary SQLite file locked during cleanup. A long installed-path guard needed formatting.
bugs.fix: Wrapped the read-only inspection connection in contextlib.closing, formatted the path guard, and reran clean-wheel smoke, 234-test suite, Ruff, mypy, and archive checks successfully.

bugs.error_message: Initial installed-agent smoke failed its Codex byte-preservation assertion on Windows; formatting and mypy also flagged a multiline expression and a heterogeneous nested dict type.
bugs.root_cause: Path.write_text translated newline bytes to CRLF on Windows, so comparing to the original LF literal was invalid; an inferred dict type was too broad for nested indexing.
bugs.fix: Captured actual pre-setup file bytes, typed the preserved Claude entry separately, simplified the comparison, and reran unit/full tests and real installed-wheel Codex/Claude handshakes successfully.

bugs.error_message: Initial refresh implementation passed functional tests but Ruff reported overlong error strings/one test assertion and formatter differences in Codex and Claude files.
bugs.root_cause: New conflict text and a follow-up Codex parse guard exceeded the repository's 100-column style while hand formatting diverged from Ruff's layout.
bugs.fix: Shortened/broke messages and conditions, reran 251-test suite, targeted refresh tests, Ruff, mypy, package rebuild, archive inspection, and clean-wheel smoke successfully.

bugs.error_message: First tokenizer benchmark run failed when default cache triggered sandbox-blocked encoding download; a broad patch placed encoding initialization in the wrong test and omitted it in the scaled test; Ruff found one overlong comprehension.
bugs.root_cause: tiktoken downloads encoding data at first get_encoding call, and similar monkeypatch context lines matched a neighboring benchmark test.
bugs.fix: Downloaded encoding data with scoped approval into ignored local cache, used TIKTOKEN_CACHE_DIR for test runs, moved initialization to the intended tests, formatted the test, and reran all gates.

bugs.error_message: An isolated package build failed when sandbox-blocked dependency installation emitted locale bytes that the build frontend could not decode; the following archive check passed against stale dist files.
bugs.root_cause: The sandbox denied Hatchling download, while a semicolon-separated PowerShell check continued after build failure.
bugs.fix: Reran the isolated build under scoped network approval as a standalone command, then checked the freshly rebuilt sdist and wheel. Do not treat a later check's exit code as proof an earlier command passed.

bugs.error_message: Strict mypy rejected slicing an object-typed JSON field in the new MCP follow-up test.
bugs.root_cause: The JSON helper intentionally returns dict[str, object], so suggested_followups must be narrowed before list slicing.
bugs.fix: Assert the field is a list before comparing its first element; full tests, Ruff, mypy, and pip check pass.

bugs.error_message: The first snapshot-diff documentation patch did not match CLI.md's exact search paragraph; an initial new-module check found one overlong line, unused imports, and a missing test helper return annotation.
bugs.root_cause: The patch assumed wording not present in the current CLI contract, and the first draft was not yet formatted/typed.
bugs.fix: Applied smaller exact-context documentation patches, added the typed helper/CLI use of imports, formatted the files, and reran targeted/full tests plus lint, mypy, and archive checks.

bugs.error_message: Constraint-diff regression initially failed because an old external-stub assertion rejected an in-scope FK named order_external_fk; a new addition test assumed all keys sort before FKs, and Ruff found an unused import.
bugs.root_cause: The tests conflated an external target stub with an in-scope constraint name and overlooked qualified-name ordering across fact kinds; quote_identifier was imported but not used.
bugs.fix: Assert only external-schema stub identities are excluded, match the deterministic qualified-name order, remove the unused import, and rerun targeted/full tests and quality gates.

bugs.error_message: New MCP diff parity test compared JSON-decoded list changes to asdict tuple changes; isolated package build could not download Hatchling and --no-isolation lacked Hatchling.
bugs.root_cause: JSON converts tuples to arrays, and the restricted sandbox cannot install the isolated build backend; Hatchling is not in the development environment.
bugs.fix: Normalized the expected dataclass through JSON, reran focused/full tests, and rebuilt successfully with scoped network approval before checking both distribution archives.

bugs.error_message: Ruff format --check rejected the wrapped new list_snapshots MCP signature; a snapshot-history test used sqlite3.connect as a context manager without closing its Windows file handle.
bugs.root_cause: The signature did not match Ruff formatting, and sqlite3 connection context managers do not close the handle.
bugs.fix: Collapsed the MCP signature and wrapped the test connection with contextlib.closing plus an inner transaction; reran focused/full tests and format/lint gates.

bugs.error_message: Ruff format --check rejected three wrapped expressions in new snapshot-diff offset code and tests.
bugs.root_cause: The handwritten line wrapping differed from Ruff's formatter output.
bugs.fix: Applied the indicated formatting, reran formatter/lint/mypy/full pytest, and verified rebuilt package archives.

bugs.error_message: Ruff found unsorted impact imports and two overlong lines; formatter then rejected handwritten many-argument FK fixtures and one MCP error assertion.
bugs.root_cause: New impact imports were placed out of alphabetical order and the initial fixture/assertion formatting differed from Ruff's rules.
bugs.fix: Sorted imports, wrapped long CLI/test lines, formatted the focused test file, and reran focused/full tests plus Ruff, mypy, pip, and package archive checks.

bugs.error_message: Ruff found unsorted column-impact MCP imports and a 101-character test line; formatter found additional handwritten test layout differences.
bugs.root_cause: New context and service imports were inserted after related symbols rather than alphabetically, and long parity/fixture assertions were manually wrapped inconsistently.
bugs.fix: Sorted imports, wrapped the overlong parity expectation, formatted the focused test file, and reran full pytest, Ruff, mypy, pip, and package archive checks.

bugs.error_message: Installed-wheel smoke only required three original MCP tools and could miss absent newer tools; Ruff found one 101-character assertion in the expanded smoke.
bugs.root_cause: The smoke's hard-coded minimum set was not updated as MCP tools grew, and the first assertion exceeded Ruff's line length.
bugs.fix: Required the full 12-tool read-only public set, added a local saved-FK column-impact call through both installed launchers, wrapped the assertion, and passed clean-wheel plus full quality gates.

bugs.error_message: README and roadmap still described implemented view and direct-impact features as planned and blurred target MVP exits with current readiness.
bugs.root_cause: Feature slices advanced faster than summary and roadmap status documentation.
bugs.fix: Corrected current workflow and feature scope, added an evidence-based readiness ledger, and separated verified local behavior from unverified release and agent outcomes.

bugs.error_message: Two context benchmark tests failed to download o200k_base.tiktoken with WinError 10013 during offline full pytest.
bugs.root_cause: The first full-suite invocation did not select the existing workspace tiktoken cache, so tiktoken attempted a blocked network fetch.
bugs.fix: Selected the existing .cache/tiktoken directory with TIKTOKEN_CACHE_DIR, reran the full suite successfully, and documented the offline command and first-download prerequisite.

bugs.error_message: A PowerShell rg command had an unterminated quote; a scanner test did not raise for an out-of-scope index row, and Ruff requested a wrapped boolean condition.
bugs.root_cause: The scripted cursor filtered out the out-of-scope row before parser validation; the initial PowerShell regex quoting was invalid and handwritten condition layout differed from Ruff.
bugs.fix: Used single-quoted PowerShell search patterns, changed the malformed fixture to an in-scope missing table, wrapped the condition, added attribute-number validation, and reran focused/full tests and quality checks.

bugs.error_message: Mypy rejected reuse of a str loop variable for an optional index key, Ruff requested fixture formatting, and the first isolated build failed during backend installation with a UnicodeDecodeError while logging pip output.
bugs.root_cause: Function-scoped loop variable types conflicted, hand-wrapped test expressions differed from Ruff, and sandboxed build dependency installation failed before producing new artifacts; the following archive check inspected older files.
bugs.fix: Renamed index loop variables, formatted the test mechanically, reran focused/full quality checks, and rebuilt in a scoped elevated environment before separately checking the fresh archives.

bugs.error_message: New index query tests referenced nonexistent StoredSnapshot.snapshot_version; Ruff found two overlong test lines and initial CLI/query formatting differences.
bugs.root_cause: The saved-snapshot result uses version whereas query context uses snapshot_version; handwritten test and adapter layout missed Ruff formatting rules.
bugs.fix: Corrected test assertions to StoredSnapshot.version, shortened the CLI expression label, formatted affected files, and reran focused/full tests plus Ruff, mypy, pip, and fresh package checks.

bugs.error_message: Ruff format found handwritten MCP test/smoke layout differences; sandboxed isolated build failed with UnicodeDecodeError while logging backend installation.
bugs.root_cause: Small async calls and a many-argument fixture differed from Ruff formatter; the isolated build dependency fetch was blocked in the sandbox and build's error logger decoded pip output as UTF-8.
bugs.fix: Formatted affected files, reran tests and quality gates, rebuilt with scoped elevation, separately inspected fresh archives, and smoke-installed the wheel in a new project-local virtual environment.

bugs.error_message: Normal-sandbox docker info reported Docker config access denied and permission denied on the docker_engine pipe despite the local daemon being available.
bugs.root_cause: The workspace sandbox could not access Docker Desktop's user config and named pipe; the daemon itself was running.
bugs.fix: Used scoped elevated read-only Docker checks, created an exact-name localhost-only auto-remove PostgreSQL 16 fixture, ran live integration tests, then stopped and verified removal of that test container.

bugs.error_message: codex --version warned 'Could not find home directory' while reporting a version; no Claude command was found on PATH.
bugs.root_cause: The sandbox cannot create Codex PATH aliases from its home location, and a Claude CLI installation is not present on PATH.
bugs.fix: Recorded Codex binary/version as availability-only evidence, documented Claude absence, and stopped before any authenticated or potentially billable model task.

bugs.error_message: Offline evaluation tests initially failed with INVALID_LIMIT because database_overview was called with 100; mypy rejected len() on object-typed packet values and an untyped monkeypatch wrapper, while Ruff found line/layout issues.
bugs.root_cause: Overview has a 50-item cap independent of table/relationship limits; generic dict values lose Sized typing, and the test wrapper did not preserve the query function signature.
bugs.fix: Used MAX_OVERVIEW_LIMIT separately, kept a typed column counter and typed wrapper, formatted both files, and reran focused/full tests plus Ruff and mypy.

bugs.error_message: Native-Windows codex sandbox probes with a custom workspace-only profile and built-in :read-only profile produced no command output and did not complete within the observation window.
bugs.root_cause: Not yet established; both profiles stalled before a model-free command could verify filesystem boundaries, while Codex also emitted nonfatal home-alias access warnings.
bugs.fix: Interrupted both probes and stopped before authenticated pilot runs; retained the synthetic offline bundle and documented the isolation requirement.

bugs.error_message: windows sandbox failed: Restricted read-only access requires the elevated Windows sandbox backend
bugs.root_cause: The native-Windows unelevated backend cannot enforce the candidate permission profile that denies reads outside the evaluation arm. The enclosing workspace sandbox also prevents ordinary nested sandbox initialization (no home dir); a model-free echo succeeds with scoped outer escalation.
bugs.fix: Kept the two-arm pilot paused. Verified Ubuntu WSL exists but has no Codex CLI or bwrap; did not change Windows admin configuration, install tools, transfer credentials, or weaken isolation.

bugs.error_message: Initial transitive-impact implementation constructed shortest paths with an undefined root identifier during editing.
bugs.root_cause: The root table ID and dependent iteration ID were conflated while adding the path reconstruction call.
bugs.fix: Named the resolved root ID separately and passed it to _reconstruct_path; focused tests, full suite, Ruff, and mypy pass.

bugs.error_message: Isolated package build failed with WinError 5 when writing .pytest-tmp/releasecheck-transitive-dist under scoped elevated execution.
bugs.root_cause: The elevated isolated build process could download Hatchling but could not create the chosen .pytest-tmp output path under this workspace's ACLs.
bugs.fix: Rebuilt into the project-local .venv directory, verified both archives and a clean-wheel Codex/Claude MCP smoke, then removed only the exact disposable build and smoke directories after path validation.

bugs.error_message: The first WSL Codex sandbox profile hid Codex's own standalone binary; an inline absolute-path permission override then failed TOML permission parsing, and the first Windows-to-WSL copy path was denied.
bugs.root_cause: A root-deny profile also needs an exact read grant for the standalone Codex release directory. Complex path grants were unreliable as CLI dotted overrides, while elevated Windows access to .pytest-tmp differed from normal workspace access.
bugs.fix: Created a temporary named profile with an exact Codex-release read grant, staged it through the already-accessible project .venv path, and verified workspace-readable/sibling-invisible behavior with model-free commands.

bugs.error_message: The WSL evaluation virtual environment could not be created because ensurepip was unavailable; the first apt attempt also found the dpkg lock held by unattended-upgrades.
bugs.root_cause: Ubuntu's python3-venv package was not installed, while a normal background package upgrade temporarily owned the package-manager lock.
bugs.fix: Waited for unattended-upgrades to release the lock without killing it, installed python3-venv, and then created the dedicated runtime successfully.

bugs.error_message: PowerShell and Bash interpreted Markdown backticks in the baseline prompt as shell syntax, attempted to run the quoted identifiers, and removed them before Codex received the prompt.
bugs.root_cause: The prompt was embedded directly in a layered PowerShell-to-WSL shell command with unescaped backticks instead of being transported as literal data.
bugs.fix: Marked the otherwise correct baseline answer protocol-invalid, retained its metrics only as invalid-run evidence, and established a rule to use plain identifiers or a prompt file/stdin transport for future runs.

bugs.error_message: The corrected Graphit Codex arm exceeded the enclosing output capture context and ended without creating its requested final-answer file.
bugs.root_cause: Not established. The ephemeral run left no persisted transcript or usage summary, no active process remained, and the final output file was absent.
bugs.fix: Counted the attempt as a failed/unanalyzable pilot sample, did not invent tool or token metrics, and stopped before any replacement model call because one-per-arm authorization was exhausted.

bugs.error_message: Layered inline PowerShell-to-WSL diagnostic commands failed with unmatched-quote and truncated Python string syntax errors.
bugs.root_cause: Nested quoting crossed JavaScript, PowerShell, WSL, Bash, and Python parsing layers.
bugs.fix: Switched to direct argument-only WSL commands and a short apply_patch-created read-only helper, then deleted the helper after inspection.

bugs.error_message: The first replacement runner stopped before model use because the isolated workspace was not a Git repository and --skip-git-repo-check was absent; a preceding FK preflight also passed the table as a nonexistent --table option.
bugs.file: WSL corrected-pilot runner and Graphit CLI preflight
bugs.root_cause: The disposable arm intentionally had no Git metadata, while the runner inherited Codex's repository check. The relationships command contract uses a positional table argument.
bugs.fix: Confirmed the transcript was zero bytes, added --skip-git-repo-check to both matched runners, used the documented positional CLI form, and then completed exactly one real replacement call per arm.

bugs.error_message: The first apply_patch import of pilot JSONL inserted blank lines between events and changed byte hashes through Windows line-ending normalization.
bugs.root_cause: Captured command output already contained line separators and the dynamic patch generator added an extra separator; the Windows workspace also normalizes text line endings.
bugs.fix: Removed inter-event blank lines with apply_patch, validated all JSON events programmatically, and recorded SHA-256 values for the normalized repository copies rather than claiming byte identity with WSL originals.

bugs.error_message: Initial compact-profile test and documentation patches failed context verification, and Ruff requested mechanical formatting in codex.py.
bugs.root_cause: The first patches reused import/text context from different files and one MCP sentence omitted the word 'not'; new code also differed from Ruff's canonical wrapping.
bugs.fix: Re-read exact local context, applied smaller patches, ran Ruff format, and then passed focused tests, full lint, formatting, and strict mypy.

bugs.error_message: A --no-isolation package build could not import hatchling; the first full-pytest capture ended without its completion event, and cleanup could not read or remove the installed-wheel target's bin directory ACL.
bugs.root_cause: Hatchling was absent from the development venv, the nested command exceeded its initial capture window, and pip's generated target bin directory has an ACL inaccessible to this managed session.
bugs.fix: Used an approved isolated build, reran pytest in a tracked session to exit 0, verified the wheel from a separate target, removed both archive directories, and retained/documented only the partially cleaned target instead of forcing ACL ownership.

bugs.error_message: The first model-free compact MCP check passed -p after the mcp list subcommand, which rejected the profile option as unexpected.
bugs.root_cause: Codex treats -p as a top-level option for this command rather than an mcp list option.
bugs.fix: Moved -p pilot before mcp list, reran without a model call, and confirmed the compact server configuration parsed successfully.

bugs.error_message: The first checksum-generation command used [IO.Path]::GetRelativePath, which is unavailable in the installed Windows PowerShell/.NET surface.
bugs.root_cause: The command assumed a newer System.IO.Path API than this PowerShell host exposes.
bugs.fix: Derived repository-relative paths from the already-resolved directory prefix, regenerated the checksum manifest, and scheduled an independent manifest verification.

bugs.error_message: The first checksum verifier resolved manifest entries from the repository root and failed to find aggregate.json.
bugs.root_cause: SHA256SUMS paths are intentionally relative to the evidence directory, not the repository root.
bugs.fix: Resolved every manifest entry against the manifest's parent directory and verified all 17 hashes successfully.

bugs.error_message: The first scaled-bundle test rejected the valid 114-table overview because entry_tables_truncated is true above the bounded 50-table overview page; Ruff also requested a one-line signature.
bugs.root_cause: The original 14-table completeness assertion treated any overview entry-table truncation as data loss, even though the packet independently enumerates and validates every expected table. The scaled corpus intentionally exceeds the overview display bound.
bugs.fix: Require the overview truncation flag to exactly match whether the expected table count exceeds MAX_OVERVIEW_LIMIT, retain per-table completeness checks, and apply Ruff's signature formatting.

bugs.error_message: The first scaled-packet proxy-token measurement attempted a blocked network fetch for o200k_base.
bugs.root_cause: The command did not point tiktoken at the repository's already-cached encoding file.
bugs.fix: Rerun with TIKTOKEN_CACHE_DIR set explicitly to .cache/tiktoken; do not request network access because the validated cache is available.

bugs.error_message: The first combined documentation patch failed because an AGENT_EVALUATION context line was matched in the wrong section.
bugs.root_cause: The large patch assumed nearby text that was actually separated by the measurements section.
bugs.fix: Re-read the exact ranges and applied smaller file-scoped patches; no partial change occurred from the failed patch.

bugs.error_message: The first approved scaled-bundle preparation could not create a child under .pytest-tmp, and PowerShell continued into dependent hash commands after the native command failed.
bugs.root_cause: The pytest-managed directory has an incompatible Windows ACL for this process, and the orchestration command did not set ErrorActionPreference or explicitly stop on the native exit code.
bugs.fix: Use a fresh explicit bundle path directly under the writable workspace, set ErrorActionPreference to Stop, and check LASTEXITCODE immediately after native commands. No model call was made.

bugs.error_message: The first WSL arm-copy command ended with an unmatched quote before executing.
bugs.root_cause: PowerShell expanded Bash-style dollar-prefixed variables inside the double-quoted bash -lc payload before Bash parsed it.
bugs.fix: Avoid cross-shell variables and rerun with explicit, single-quoted paths in a PowerShell literal payload. The parse failure occurred before workspace creation or model use.

bugs.error_message: The relative-path WSL copy succeeded, but its trailing stat command lost the quoted format argument and exited before the file listing.
bugs.root_cause: Windows-to-WSL argument translation again stripped nested quotes in the bash -lc payload; the mutating copy steps had already completed successfully and hashes were printed.
bugs.fix: Use quote-free wc/find validation commands for the remaining preflight and avoid nested formatted arguments. No model call was made.

bugs.error_message: The first scaled-arm Codex sandbox preflight loaded profile file pilot but omitted the required explicit --permission-profile argument.
bugs.root_cause: codex sandbox distinguishes the configuration profile (-p pilot) from the named permissions profile (-P pilot), unlike codex exec which resolves default_permissions from the loaded profile.
bugs.fix: Add -P pilot to every model-free sandbox probe and rerun both own-readable and sibling-invisible checks. No model call was made.

bugs.error_message: The direct Windows-to-WSL codex mcp get preflight stripped TOML array quotes, so Codex parsed mcp_servers.graphit.args as a string instead of a sequence.
bugs.root_cause: Nested TOML quoting did not survive direct PowerShell/WSL argument translation, although the copied POSIX runner file retains the correct literal arguments.
bugs.fix: Create a short apply_patch-managed POSIX preflight script with the exact runner overrides, copy it into WSL, and execute it there. No model call was made.

bugs.error_message: The first scaled evidence diagnostic printed the baseline packet embedded in JSONL and was display-truncated; the dynamic apply_patch import also added one extra terminal newline to each file.
bugs.root_cause: Grep selected the full command result instead of only event metadata, and the patch generator represented an existing terminal newline as an extra empty added line.
bugs.fix: Validate JSONL with a structured parser, then re-import each raw file after removing exactly one terminal newline before apply_patch adds its canonical newline. Record repository-copy hashes separately.

bugs.error_message: Visualization inspection attempted to read nonexistent src/graphit/graph_projection.py.
bugs.root_cause: The graph projection filename was inferred instead of located first; GraphProjection is defined in graph_export.py.
bugs.fix: Located the actual definition with rg, read graph_export.py, and continued from the established projection contract without creating a duplicate module.

bugs.error_message: Focused interactive-HTML tests passed, but Ruff reported unsorted standard-library imports in graph_html.py and test_graph_html.py.
bugs.root_cause: New hashlib/re imports were placed after from-imports instead of Ruff's canonical straight-import-first ordering.
bugs.fix: Reordered only the affected imports with apply_patch, then repeated focused quality gates.

bugs.error_message: The first combined visualization documentation patch failed on a ROADMAP context mismatch.
bugs.file: README.md; docs/CLI.md; docs/VISUALIZATION.md; docs/ROADMAP.md; related docs
bugs.root_cause: The patch expected a lowercase phase-exit sentence split differently from the actual ROADMAP text.
bugs.fix: Re-read the exact ROADMAP ranges and applied smaller documentation patches; the failed patch made no partial changes.

bugs.error_message: openwolf sync could not launch through openwolf.ps1 because the Windows PowerShell execution policy disables scripts.
bugs.root_cause: PowerShell command resolution selected the npm-generated .ps1 shim, which this machine's execution policy blocks.
bugs.fix: Use the npm-generated openwolf.cmd shim directly if present; do not weaken the system execution policy.

bugs.error_message: The installed OpenWolf CLI rejected the documented sync subcommand as unknown.
bugs.root_cause: This installed OpenWolf version exposes a different command surface than the project guidance assumed.
bugs.fix: Inspect openwolf.cmd --help and use the supported non-network anatomy refresh command rather than guessing or editing generated hashes manually.

bugs.error_message: openwolf scan --check reported anatomy out of date immediately after two successful full scans.
bugs.root_cause: The installed OpenWolf check appears to compare state that its own scan output changes or otherwise disagrees with the just-written index; the refreshed graph_html description and symbols are present.
bugs.fix: Retained the successfully regenerated 158-file anatomy, verified the changed entries directly, recorded the CLI incompatibility, and stopped repeating the non-converging check.

bugs.error_message: Copyright-package focused tests passed, but Ruff requested two formatting changes and mypy rejected reusing notice_path as both pathlib.Path and wheel member str.
bugs.root_cause: The NOTICE validation patch reused one variable name across filesystem and archive namespaces and differed from Ruff's canonical wrapping.
bugs.fix: Separated repository_notice_path from wheel_notice_path and applied the requested formatting before rerunning all focused gates.

bugs.error_message: The first attribution artifact build failed while build decoded isolated pip subprocess output as UTF-8; byte 0xfe caused UnicodeDecodeError before any artifact was produced.
bugs.root_cause: The build frontend and Windows pip subprocess disagreed on output encoding while bootstrapping Hatchling in a temporary isolated environment; this is not a project source or metadata validation failure.
bugs.fix: Install the declared Hatchling backend into the disposable development venv and run the same PEP 517 build with --no-isolation, then validate the artifacts independently.

bugs.error_message: The first Hatchling installation attempt exhausted retries because sandboxed network access to the package index was blocked.
bugs.root_cause: Hatchling was not cached as an installed package and the default sandbox denies external package-index connections.
bugs.fix: Repeated the exact scoped pip install with user-approved network escalation; Hatchling 1.32.4 and its missing backend dependencies installed successfully.

bugs.error_message: scripts/smoke_installed.py --help failed because the script has no command-line parser and detected Graphit from the source tree.
bugs.root_cause: The packaging smoke script was mistakenly treated as a CLI with a help flag; it is intended to run without arguments under the interpreter of an isolated wheel installation.
bugs.fix: Read the script and CI invocation, then use a disposable virtual environment containing the built wheel and invoke the script without arguments.

bugs.error_message: The first disposable wheel smoke environment lacked mcp, psycopg, and typer, so pip check and executable startup failed.
bugs.root_cause: A virtual environment created by another virtual environment still inherits only the base Python's global site packages; --system-site-packages did not expose the parent development venv dependencies, and the wheel was intentionally installed with --no-deps.
bugs.fix: Install the wheel normally with its declared runtime dependencies inside the disposable environment before rerunning the smoke test.

bugs.error_message: The escalated dependency installation could not execute the disposable environment's python.exe and returned Windows UnauthorizedAccessException.
bugs.root_cause: The elevated execution boundary could not access the workspace-created nested virtual-environment executable, despite normal sandbox execution being able to use it.
bugs.fix: Avoid elevation for this disposable executable; expose the already-installed development dependencies through a local .pth file while keeping Graphit itself installed from the built wheel.

bugs.error_message: The local dependency bridge made pip check pass but MCP startup could not import pywintypes.
bugs.root_cause: Adding the parent venv's site-packages directory does not recursively process its pywin32.pth, so pywin32's win32, win32/lib, pythonwin, and bootstrap entries were absent.
bugs.fix: Mirror the exact local pywin32.pth paths and bootstrap import in the disposable environment's dependency bridge, without changing product source or package metadata.

bugs.error_message: The first combined attribution-documentation patch failed on an ADR-057 context mismatch.
bugs.root_cause: The large multi-file patch expected a different line break around ADR-057 than the current document contained.
bugs.fix: Confirmed the failed patch made no partial changes, reread the exact section, and applied smaller targeted patches.

bugs.error_message: The combined final gate invoked scripts/check_dist.py with an unsupported --dist-dir argument, so the script checked the stale default dist directory and rejected its older source archive.
bugs.root_cause: check_dist.py exposes check_distributions(root, dist_dir) as a Python function but its __main__ block has no argument parser and always selects root/dist.
bugs.fix: Build the current candidate into a fresh explicit directory and call check_distributions with that exact Path from Python.

bugs.error_message: Temporary cleanup preflight tried to resolve an already-removed .pytest-tmp attribution smoke environment and then called StartsWith on a null path.
bugs.root_cause: The full pytest run had already cleaned the shared .pytest-tmp contents after the installed-wheel smoke completed.
bugs.fix: Treat the absent smoke environment as already cleaned and remove only the two existing artifact directories whose resolved workspace containment was verified.

bugs.error_message: The web reader returned an internal cache-miss error while opening the supplied GitHub repository URL.
bugs.root_cause: The web fetch path could not populate the GitHub page from its cache.
bugs.fix: Verified the repository directly with read-only git ls-remote instead.

bugs.error_message: The sandboxed git ls-remote could not connect to github.com:443.
bugs.root_cause: Default sandbox networking blocks direct GitHub access.
bugs.fix: Repeated the exact read-only ls-remote with scoped network approval; it succeeded and returned no refs, confirming an empty repository.

bugs.error_message: Adding origin first failed on sandbox .git/config permissions, then elevated Git rejected the repository as dubious ownership.
bugs.root_cause: The workspace .git directory is owned by the sandbox identity while elevated Git runs as the desktop user.
bugs.fix: Used a command-local safe.directory setting with scoped approval, avoiding any global Git configuration change; origin was added successfully.

bugs.error_message: Repository-URL distribution tests and Ruff checks passed, but Ruff format requested one single-line generator expression in check_dist.py.
bugs.root_cause: The initial patch wrapped a short sorted generator more broadly than Ruff's canonical formatter.
bugs.fix: Apply Ruff formatting to the affected file and repeat the focused gates.

bugs.error_message: Initial staging emitted Windows LF-to-CRLF warnings and git diff --cached --check reported terminal blank lines, including immutable evaluation evidence.
bugs.root_cause: The new repository had no Git attributes despite an LF editor policy, and raw evidence intentionally preserves exact hashed bytes that can violate generic whitespace checks.
bugs.fix: Add repository LF attributes, remove two non-evidence terminal blank lines, and disable whitespace normalization/checking only for exact captured evidence so published checksums remain valid.

bugs.error_message: GitHub CLI status checks failed because gh is not installed on this Windows environment.
bugs.root_cause: The repository was pushed through Git credential support, but the separate gh executable is absent from PATH.
bugs.fix: Use GitHub's read-only REST API for repository, run, job, and check status without installing another tool.

bugs.error_message: The first public GitHub CI run passed Python 3.11-3.14 tests but failed its combined isolated-wheel smoke step; unauthenticated job-log download returned HTTP 403 admin required.
bugs.root_cause: The workflow combined wheel installation, pip/CLI checks, and init/MCP smoke into one shell step, while the public API exposed only its aggregate exit code and not the authenticated log.
bugs.fix: Split the smoke workflow into separately named install, package/CLI, and init/MCP steps so the next public check identifies the exact failing boundary without reading credentials.

bugs.error_message: A local WSL reproduction probe found Python 3.12 and venv support but no pip module or uv executable.
bugs.root_cause: The existing WSL environment was prepared for isolated Codex evaluation, not Python package building.
bugs.fix: Avoid changing the WSL system solely for diagnosis; improve CI step granularity and use its public job/step results first.

bugs.error_message: The second public CI run proved wheel installation and CLI checks pass, but installed init/MCP smoke fails on Ubuntu.
bugs.root_cause: local_mcp_launch resolved sys.executable. POSIX venv Python is a symlink, so resolution escaped .package-smoke to the base interpreter where Graphit was not installed; Windows venv executables did not expose this.
bugs.fix: Use the absolute active interpreter path without dereferencing symlinks, update launcher expectations, and add a symlink regression test before rerunning installed-wheel CI.

bugs.error_message: The first combined MCP launcher fix patch failed because the expected docs/MCP.md sentence came from docs/TESTING.md instead.
bugs.root_cause: A cross-file documentation phrase was applied as patch context in the wrong document.
bugs.fix: Confirmed no partial changes, applied the code/tests independently, then reread and patched the exact MCP and decision sections.

bugs.error_message: The web reader returned cache-miss errors for the graphit-db PyPI JSON and project URLs.
bugs.root_cause: The web fetch path could not populate these uncached PyPI endpoints.
bugs.fix: Queried the official PyPI JSON API directly with read-only network approval; it returned HTTP 404 for graphit-db.

bugs.error_message: The first direct PyPI JSON request could not connect inside the default sandbox.
bugs.root_cause: Default sandbox networking blocks direct PyPI access.
bugs.fix: Repeated only the official read-only endpoint with scoped network approval; graphit-db was absent at the check time.

bugs.error_message: The first combined release-documentation patch failed because the expected README release-readiness lines wrapped differently.
bugs.root_cause: A large multi-file patch used stale README line wrapping after earlier absolute-link edits.
bugs.fix: Confirmed no partial changes, applied workflow/docs separately, reread the exact README range, and patched it narrowly.
